title: Scaffolds for Higher Tropical Grassmannians: Foundations
summary: Scaffolds are the one-dimensional skeleta of high-dimensional flag simplicial complexes of nonpositive curvature. They generalize the phylogenetic trees of Trop G(2,n) to arbitrary $k$, drawing together SL(k)-web bases, affine buildings, the combinatorics of the positive tropical Grassmannian and low-dimensional topology. We prove that scaffolds model points in all tropical Grassmannians via a $k$-point distance function.
